title: "PREVENTAMI-FX — PREvention of  VENtricular Thrombosis in Acute Myocardial Infarction with FondaparinuX"
official: "PREVENTAMI-FX — PREvention of  VENtricular Thrombosis in Acute Myocardial Infarction with FondaparinuX"
summary: Main objective: To evaluate whether fondaparinux (2.5 mg s.c. once daily until Day 10 inclusive), started within 3 hours of primary PCI for anterior infarction, reduces the incidence of LVT detected by contrast-enhanced echocardiography during the first 30 days after the index event. Co-primary safety objective: to quantify the excess of clinically relevant bleeding (BARC type 3-5) attributable to the addition of fondaparinux to standard antithrombotic therapy through Day 30.
conditions: Acute anterior myocardial infarction with systolic dysfunction.

interventions.name: Arixtra 2.5 mg/0.5 ml solution for injection, pre-filled syringe.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. ≥18 years. 2. Anterior STEMI with documented apical dysfunction after primary angioplasty and one of the following: a. Primary PCI performed >12 hours after the onset of symptoms b. TIMI flow at the end of PCI <3 or MBG <3 c. EF <45% 3.  Informed consent from the patient or, where the patient is temporarily incapacitated in the emergency setting, in accordance with the procedure described in the section “Acquisition of Informed Consent”.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Contraindications to fondaparinux (active bleeding, hypersensitivity). 2. Severe renal impairment (defined as eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m²). 3. Chronic oral anticoagulation. 4. Known coagulopathies or severe thrombocytopenia. 5. Need for therapeutic anticoagulation. 6. Pregnancy or breastfeeding. 7. Echocardiographic evidence of  LVT  before randomization. 8. Contraindications to CMR and severe gadolinium allergies. 9. Very high bleeding risk defined as a CRUSADE bleeding risk score >40 at screening. 10. Acute bacterial endocarditis. 11. Any history of intracranial haemorrhage. 12. Clinically significant gastrointestinal or genitourinary bleeding within the previous 3 months. 13. Major surgery, major trauma, neurosurgery, spinal surgery or intraocular surgery within the previous 30 days, or planned during the treatment period. 14. Participation in another interventional clinical trial in which an investigational medicinal product was administered within 30 days of screening or within 5 half-lives of that investigational product, whichever is longer. 15. Body weight <45 kg. 16. Life expectancy <6 months for non-cardiac reasons. 17. Concomitant fibrinolytic therapy for the index event, or fibrinolysis administered within the previous 24 hours. 18. Contraindication to ultrasound enhancing agents. 19. Known hypersensitivity to gadolinium-based contrast agents.
